# @kurto/payload-seo-advanced

> Advanced SEO plugin for Payload CMS 3.x. Extends the core `@payloadcms/plugin-seo` with global SEO settings, advanced per-page fields, and Schema.org structured data.

- All features beyond base meta fields are opt-in. Pass `true` for defaults or an object for fine-grained control.
- Peer dependencies: `payload`, `@payloadcms/ui`, `@payloadcms/translations` (all `^3.74.0`)
- Install: `pnpm add @kurto/payload-seo-advanced`

## Plugin Config (`SEOPluginConfig`)

```ts
import { payloadSeoAdvanced } from '@kurto/payload-seo-advanced'

payloadSeoAdvanced({
  collections: ['pages', 'posts'],       // CollectionSlug[] — collections to add SEO fields to
  globals: ['homepage'],                  // GlobalSlug[] — globals to add SEO fields to
  uploadsCollection: 'media',            // enables meta image field and global OG image
  tabbedUI: true,                        // wrap content + SEO in tabbed layout
  interfaceName: 'SEO Metadata',         // custom interface name for the meta group field
  generateTitle: ({ doc }) => doc?.title ?? '',
  generateDescription: ({ doc }) => doc?.excerpt ?? '',
  generateImage: ({ doc }) => doc?.featuredImage,
  generateURL: ({ doc, collectionConfig }) =>
    `https://example.com/${collectionConfig?.slug}/${doc?.slug}`,
  fieldsOverride: ({ defaultFields }) => defaultFields,  // override meta fields array
  globalSettings: true,                  // boolean | GlobalSettingsConfig
  advancedFields: true,                  // boolean | AdvancedFieldsConfig
  structuredData: true,                  // boolean | StructuredDataConfig
})
```

## Global Settings (`globalSettings`)

Creates an SEO Settings global in the admin panel. Fields: `siteName`, `titleSeparator` (select: `-`, `|`, `•`), `defaults.ogImage` (upload), `defaults.fallbackDescription` (textarea), `knowledgeGraph` blocks field (maxRows: 1) with `organization` and `person` block types, `indexing.noindex` (checkbox).

**Knowledge Graph blocks:**
- **Organization block**: `name`, `logo` (upload, if uploadsCollection configured), `contactEmail`, `contactPhone`, `address` (group with street, city, state, postal, country), `socialLinks` (array)
- **Person block**: `name`, `contactEmail`, `contactPhone`, `socialLinks` (array)

```ts
globalSettings: {
  slug: 'seo-settings',          // default: 'seo-settings'
  adminGroup: 'SEO',             // default: auto-detected
  access: { read: () => true },
  fieldsOverride: ({ defaultFields }) => defaultFields,
}
```

When enabled, the auto-generate title endpoint appends the site name using the configured separator.

## Advanced Fields (`advancedFields`)

Adds per-page fields after the SERP preview. All default to `true` when `advancedFields` is enabled.

```ts
advancedFields: {
  canonicalUrl: true,    // auto-populated via beforeChange hook using generateURL
  robotsMeta: true,      // select: index/noindex, follow/nofollow
  focusKeyword: true,    // localized text field
}
```

## Structured Data (`structuredData`)

Adds Schema.org structured data using a Payload `blocks` field (maxRows: 1). Each schema type is its own block with flat fields. With the Postgres adapter's `blocksAsJSON: true` option (user-configured), blocks store as JSON columns rather than proliferating database columns.

```ts
structuredData: {
  schemaTypes: ['article', 'product', 'localBusiness'],  // default: all types
  fieldsOverride: ({ defaultFields }) => defaultFields,
}
```

Available block types: `article`, `product`, `service`, `event`, `localBusiness`. Each block has flat fields directly on the block (no nested groups):

| Block Type | Fields |
|---|---|
| `article` | `author` (text), `publishDate` (date) |
| `product` | `price` (number), `currency` (text, default: USD), `inStock` (checkbox) |
| `service` | `serviceType` (text), `provider` (text), `areaServed` (text) |
| `event` | `startDate` (date), `endDate` (date), `locationName` (text), `locationAddress` (text) |
| `localBusiness` | `businessType` (text), `priceRange` (text), `useGlobalAddress` (checkbox), `address` (group with `streetAddress`, `city`, `state`, `postalCode`, `country`) |

**Data shape:** `meta.structuredData` is an array with a single block: `[{ blockType: 'article', id: 'abc', author: '...', publishDate: '...' }]`

**Postgres users:** Enable `blocksAsJSON: true` in your Postgres adapter configuration to store blocks as single JSON columns rather than creating separate tables. This significantly improves schema flexibility and reduces migration complexity.

## `fieldsOverride` Pattern

Every feature area exposes a `fieldsOverride` callback: `(args: { defaultFields: Field[] }) => Field[]`. This gives full programmatic control over which fields are included.

## Export Paths

| Path | Contents |
|---|---|
| `@kurto/payload-seo-advanced` | `payloadSeoAdvanced` plugin function |
| `@kurto/payload-seo-advanced/types` | All TypeScript types (`SEOPluginConfig`, `AdvancedFieldsConfig`, `GlobalSettingsConfig`, `StructuredDataConfig`, etc.) |
| `@kurto/payload-seo-advanced/fields` | Individual field factory functions |
| `@kurto/payload-seo-advanced/client` | React components (for Payload admin UI) |
| `@kurto/payload-seo-advanced/utilities` | `generateSchema(doc, globalSettings?)` — pure function returning JSON-LD object or `null` |

## `generateSchema` Utility

```ts
import { generateSchema } from '@kurto/payload-seo-advanced/utilities'

const jsonLd = generateSchema(page, seoSettings)
// Returns JSON-LD object or null if minimum required fields are missing
```

Extracts the first block from `doc.meta.structuredData[]` array and routes to type-specific builders based on `blockType`. For `localBusiness` blocks with `useGlobalAddress: true`, falls back to `seoSettings.knowledgeGraph[0].address` (first knowledge graph block).

Minimum requirements: Article needs title, Product needs price, Service needs title, Event needs startDate, Local Business needs title.
